prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph. It is a birthday party invitation page: a wood-type poster whose cast is five friendly object-characters.

STRUCTURE: one continuous posted sheet, edge to edge, no margins, no cards, no navigation bar. FIVE horizontal colour bands stack down the screen, ALL FIVE of exactly equal height and equal visual weight, none dominant. The band colours in order are SUN YELLOW, POOL TURQUOISE, WATERMELON PINK, COBALT BLUE and MANGO ORANGE, flat and fully saturated.

Each band carries, side by side, one enormous condensed wood-type word in dense near-black ink cropped hard by the screen edges, AND one anthropomorphic object-character drawn as flat vector art with confident even-weight thick outlines, no shading, two simple round expressive eyes with tiny highlights, a small happy mouth, and thin rubber-hose arms and legs with rounded feet. The five characters are all the same size and equally prominent:
  Band 1, word HBD, character: a BIRTHDAY CAKE with exactly FIVE lit candles, arms raised in celebration. It is the largest-feeling character and the clear heart of the poster.
  Band 2, word SUMMER, character: an inflatable RING FLOAT standing on two legs, leaning back happily.
  Band 3, word PARTY, character: a folded TOWEL with legs, mid-stride as if running to the pool.
  Band 4, word 8.28, character: a SWIMSUIT on two legs, waving.
  Band 5, word 17:00, character: a cheerful SUN with a face and little arms.

At the very bottom edge, a narrow strip of poster cream carrying a small line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in tight dense condensed characters in near-black.

PALETTE, strictly: sun yellow, pool turquoise, watermelon pink, cobalt blue, mango orange, poster cream, and dense near-black ink, plus small warm orange candle flames. No other colour. Flat silkscreen colour, no gradients, no shading.

Loud, playful, celebratory, quirky, friendly, drawn for adults rather than for a nursery. No people, no human faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond what is specified.
